corrections.old_text: እንዲህ ፡ ባለ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወንጌል ፡ ጽና ፡ ተረዳ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: እንዲህ ፡ ባለ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወንጌል ፡ ጸና ፡ ተረዳ ፡
corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 1st-order 'ጸ' (ጸና - 'became strong/firm', glossing Ge'ez ፀንዐ), not 6th-order 'ጽ'.

In Classical Ge'ez imperfective 1st person plural passive/reflexive (ዘንትመነስ - 'that we are despised/harmed'), the final consonant takes the 6th order 'ስ', which is clearly visible on the page with its top-left bend.
Nominative predicate 'ብዙኅ' ('great is her majesty') has the 6th-order 'ኅ' with its top hook clearly printed, not 4th-order 'ኀ'.
